subject: Draft MAP — SDK streaming & toolcall integration: owners, milestones, risks
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@healthaxis.ai>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@healthaxis.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & integration checklist (post-call recap)

Hi Alyssa / Michael — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment on the MAP milestone that covers the SDK/streaming/tool-calling work: 

Summary (what we discussed)
- Primary integration path: HealthAxis will embed Redwood SDK for request/response generation, and enable streaming for live transcription->assist flows.
- Tool calling: HealthAxis wants structured outputs and deterministic tool calls for order-of-operations in their clinician assistant.
- Success criteria: proof-of-concept with streaming + function/tool calls, structured-output schema validation, and an internal perf target of p95 latency < 350ms for single-request streaming fragments.

Proposed MAP milestone items (draft) — see attached MAP_draft_v1.xlsx for table view:
1) SDK integration (client libs + sample app) — Owner: Priyom Das (Redwood) / HealthAxis eng lead TBD — Target: 2026-08-21
2) Streaming enablement (continuous chunked responses + KV cache checks) — Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood) — Target: 2026-09-01
3) Tool-calling mapping (function contract + schema + error handling policy) — Owner: Neha Kapoor (Redwood) — Target: 2026-09-08
4) Structured outputs & validation harness (schema tests + rollout gates) — Owner: HealthAxis / Redwood (shared) — Target: 2026-09-15

Dependencies & risks
- Procurement signoff on dedicated capacity (HealthAxis) — blocks final SLA and reserved throughput.
- Security review (SOC2 + data residency checklist) — you mentioned a 3-week internal review.
- Schema freeze — changes to the structured output schema after integration can add 2+ sprints of rework.

Action items (short)
- Alyssa: confirm HealthAxis eng owner for SDK integration and procurement timeline (by EOD Mon 8/2)
- Michael: share procurement calendar / SOW template (if you have one)
- Neha / Ben / I: we'll update the MAP spreadsheet with more granular tasks and a risk log and circulate by EOD Fri 7/31.

Attachments: [Attachment: MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [Attachment: SDK_integration_brief.pdf (pdf)]
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AExampleSharedDrive/Integration-MAP

Thanks — looking forward to locking owners so we can map to a target close.

—Priyom

Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 20:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & integration checklist (post-call recap)

Thanks Priyom — clear and helpful summary. A few clarifying Qs from our side: 

1) Streaming + function/tool calling: can Redwood support streaming responses while also emitting structured function-calls mid-stream (we need to call downstream services as tokens arrive)? If so, any known limitations on SDKs (Java/Node) we should plan for?
2) Security/compliance: we'll run the SOC2 checklist in parallel. Can you confirm whether Private deployment (VPC) is required for the POC or if hosted with contractual controls is sufficient for the proof-of-concept?
3) Procurement / SOW: we typically need a draft SOW + estimates to route to procurement — can Michael or someone from your side share a template? Our procurement team wants to know target budget range to categorize the request.

We can confirm an eng owner for SDK integration by Monday; leaning toward assigning to our platform lead (TBD) who will partner with Redwood. Regarding timeline, procurement has heavy review in late-August, so our target close may need to be mid-September. I'll confirm final dates after I sync with procurement.

A couple notes inline from the call: 
> On support for structured outputs: we need deterministic schemas and a small failure/retry strategy documented.

Appreciate the quick follow-up.

—Alyssa
Alyssa Chen

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & integration checklist (post-call recap)

Hi Alyssa / team — thanks for the questions. Quick technical clarifications and an updated, more implementation-oriented milestone checklist (we'll add this to the MAP spreadsheet and the Drive folder): 

Technical answers
- Streaming + function calls: Redwood runtime supports interleaving streaming token emission with function-call invocation semantics. In practice we emit a structured function-call event as soon as the model indicates a call; the SDK bridges the event to a callback handler in your app. Node and Java SDKs both support streaming callbacks — the primary limitation is that some older HTTP proxies can buffer chunked responses; we'll include recommended headers and retry semantics in the SDK guide.
- Hosted vs Private for POC: Hosted is acceptable for the POC if you accept contractual controls (contractual data scoping + dedicated tenant). If procurement requires hardened controls, Private (VPC) is the path for production. We'll surface both options in the SOW draft.

Updated integration build plan (implementation milestones, owners, and top risks)
- Milestone A: SDK integration + sample app (Priyom / HealthAxis eng owner) — Target 2026-08-21 — Risk: HealthAxis eng lead availability
- Milestone B: Streaming enablement + perf test harness (Ben Carter) — Target 2026-09-01 — Risk: proxy buffering, mitigation: test harness and alternate chunking headers
- Milestone C: Tool-call contract + schema / deterministic mapping (Neha Kapoor) — Target 2026-09-08 — Risk: schema churn, mitigation: freeze + validation harness
- Milestone D: Structured output validation + rollout gates (Joint) — Target 2026-09-15 — Risk: late change requests 

Deliverables we'll produce in the POC phase
- SDK sample repo with streaming + function-callback examples (Node/Java)
- Test harness for structured-output schema validation (JSON Schema + sample prompt sets)
- Short operations runbook for error modes and fallback to non-streaming paths

Next steps (we'll do these immediately)
- I'll update the MAP_draft_v1.xlsx with task-level owners and a risk log by EOD Fri (7/31).
- Priyom: can you share a draft SOW template for HealthAxis procurement?
- Alyssa: confirm your eng owner + procurement milestone when you have it.

Attachments referenced will be added to the Drive folder.

—Neha
